Sarjapur, Bangalore, is a densely populated and rapidly growing suburb that has become one of the rental hotspots. With its superb connectivity, located in proximity to the main IT parks, and the amenities count, it is no wonder that so many people are deciding to call Sarjapur home. But trying to find your ideal flat is daunting. That's where this guide steps in, with the intention of making your search easier, giving you everything you need to navigate the rental market in Sarjapur successfully.

    Understanding Sarjapur's Appeal for Renters  

      Connectivity and Accessibility  

      Sarjapur has perfect connectivity to all the other significant areas of Bangalore, including Whitefield, Electronic City, and Outer Ring Road. This easy commute to office will save your precious time as well as create less stress in your life. You'll surely love traveling by any means in Sarjapur, be it public transport or your personal car.

      Have you ever spent hours in traffic? Sarjapur would like to limit that aggravation. I know someone who relocated to Sarjapur just to reduce their commuting time, and they were going on and on about how much extra time they had for hobbies and family.


      Proximity to IT Hubs and Business Parks        

      One of the major attractions of Sarjapur is that it is close to major IT parks and business parks. This allows most IT professionals to reside near their workplaces, saving on commute time and enhancing work-life balance.

      Here's a brief rundown of some of the nearby IT parks:

      Tech ParkDistance from Sarjapur
      Embassy Tech Village8-10 km
      RMZ Ecoworld5-7 km
      Prestige Tech Park12-15 km
      Cessna Business Park10-12 km
      Electronic City15-20 km

      Social Infrastructure  

      Sarjapur also boasts an extensively developed social infrastructure, including various schools, hospitals, malls, and recreational options. Therefore, you can be sure to find all the comforts you need to live life smoothly.

      • Schools: There are a few quality schools in Sarjapur to provide the best education to your kids.
      • Hospitals: Quality healthcare is important, and Sarjapur provides plenty of hospitals and clinics.
      • Shopping Centers: From everyday essentials to shopping therapy, Sarjapur has plenty of shopping to choose from.

      Green Spaces and Environment  

      Nature lovers will enjoy the open spaces and relatively clean surroundings of Sarjapur. Unlike some parts of more traffic-congested Bangalore, Sarjapur is a welcome change of pace to live in.

      • Parks and Lakes
      • Tree-lined road
      • Less hectic environment

      Overall Quality of Life  

      On the whole, Sarjapur is a high standard of living place with convenience, comfort, and connectivity. Thus, it is an ideal place for families, young professionals, and anyone wanting a quiet but well-connected residence. I used to visit my friend who stayed in Sarjapur, and I was amazed at how carefree and cheerful everyone appeared to be. It is surely a place where you can relax.

Types of Flats Available for Rent in Sarjapur  

When searching for flats for rent in Sarjapur near Wipro, you'll discover a range of flats to meet various budgets and requirements. From small studio flats to large 3BHK flats, there's something for everyone. I understand it can be overwhelming to sort through all the various types, so let's simplify it:

1 BHK Flats: Ideal for Singles and Young Professionals  

A 1BHK (one bedroom, hall, kitchen) flat is perfect if you are single or a young professional on a budget. The flats generally provide a bedroom, a living room, a kitchen, and a bathroom. When I moved to Bangalore initially, a 1BHK was just right – warm and the ideal size for one!

  • Affordable
  • Easy to maintain

2 BHK Flats: Suitable for Small Families and Couples  

A 2BHK (two bedrooms, hall, kitchen) apartment is also a favorite of small families and couples. It offers more room and privacy than 1BHKS, two bedrooms, living space, kitchen, and generally two bathrooms. My cousin moved into a new 2BHK in Sarjapur last month with his wife, and they enjoy having additional space for guests or a home workspace.

  • More room and privacy
  • Ideal for small families and couples


3 BHK Flats: Perfect for Larger Families or Those Needing Extra Space  

    If you have a bigger family or just require extra space, then a 3BHK (three bedrooms, hall, kitchen) flat would be a perfect option. They provide enough space for all with three bedrooms, a large hall, a kitchen, and more than one bathroom.

Step-by-Step Process to Search for a Rental Flat in Sarjapur on 99acres

  • Go to 99acres website.
  • Click on "Rent" tab.
  • Enter "Sarjapur" or the surrounding area.
  • Select property type as flat.

How to Improve Your Success Rate in Finding a Rental Flat in Sarjapur

    Now that listings are outdated, and some owners never remove them, do the following to stand a better chance:

    • Fresh Listings First
      Employ only new postings or those with very few reviews.
    • Call Rather Than Messaging
      Calling gets very quick responses, and anyway, if a flat is rented out ask them for the same.
    • Contact More Owners and Brokers
      Call as many owners (at least 10) and on other sites.
    • Managed Properties
      The inventories would have been maintained updated by the property managers, for instance, KOTS, therefore ensuring proper availability.
    • Visit In Person for Quicker Deals
      Be punctual, and pay visits to the properties personally.
    • Negotiate Wisely
      Offer token advance and demand greater benefits such as extra-time for movability or rent discount.

      

    Things to Consider After Finalizing a Rental House

    Budget: Your rent is proportional to your income.
    Legal: Verify the title deeds, agreements, and contracts.
    Neighborhood: Ensure it is safe, near work, school, and is family-oriented.
    Size and Layout of the House: Keep the room as well as affordability.

    Pricing and Budget Considerations:  

    The average rental and purchase rates in Bellandur vary depending on being near all major areas and amenities.      
    Prices depend on house types and location.    

    How to Narrow Down Your Search:

    Apply filters such as price, location, and amenities. Gradually activate your main requirements like transportation time and safety of the location. Finally, see the properties for yourself to know more about the area.
